metadata.title: Most Insider Trades Aren't Buys
metadata.primary_source: Gomathy S., Mycroft insider-signals module, committed audit files at mycroft-work commit fed487c (conformance-audit.md, conformance_summary.json, 14 parse summaries, status.md, PRE_REGISTRATION.md); underlying data: SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets 2023 Q2 – 2026 Q3
metadata.reformat: full-length; native portrait graphics; preserve source framing

short_validation.note: B01/B02/B03/B05/B06/B07/B11 authored as native portrait Manim scenes in vertical/scenes.py

beats.narration_text: Hi — Bella, in for Gomathy. An insider buys stock. Is that a signal?

show.event: composer sits empty, spark idle
the ask types itself into the composer
send arms
three output lines land — the ask lands answered

output: First, count what's really a buy.
Then filter the buys that remain.

qc.sparse_reason: Hesitant-writer beat: short typed lines on a mostly-cream page (house exemption named in final_frame_check.py's sparse_by_design_beats() docstring).

beats.narration_text: A Form 4 isn't just buying. It's any change in an insider's holdings, due within two business days.

show.event: 'A Form 4 is' / 'an insider' / 'buying.' types in
the wrong lines dim and backspaces out
'any change in' / 'an insider's' / 'holdings, due' / 'within two' / 'business days.' types in its place

beats.narration_text: Gomathy's audit counted almost a million Form 4 transactions.

show.event: title 'Every Form 4 / Transaction', meta 'Non-derivative table'; counter starts at 0
counter rolls up to 999,542 on 'almost a million'
14 quarter ticks (two rows of seven) fill, 'Q2 2023 – Q3 2026' / '14 quarters, filing date'
source line 'Source: SEC Insider / Transactions Data Sets' settles

beats.narration_text: Most aren't buys. Purchases are about eight percent.

show.event: title 'Most Aren't Buys'; source line 'Share of 999,542 rows'
one bar per code lands top to bottom on 'Most aren't buys': Sales (S) 30.2%, Grants, awards (A) 21.8%, Tax/exercise (F) 17.1%, Option exercises (M) 14.4%, All other codes 8.3%
'Purchases (P) 8.2%' lands last, solid ink, and is boxed on 'eight percent'

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in p-value, knowledge-cutoff and claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: Those are coded P. After checks, about seventy-eight thousand remain.

show.event: title 'Code P: Purchases' settles
items reveal in order: 82,340 code P rows, −3,845 failed checks, 78,495 qualifying buys

beats.narration_text: Then filters remove private deals, employee plans, late filings, and stocks under a dollar.

show.event: title 'Registered Filters'; 'Qualifying buys 78,495' bar; footer '10b5-1: kept, flagged' / 'Joint filing: 1 insider' settles at the bottom
'Repeat amendments −699' steps down as 'Then filters' begins
'Private, ESPP, DRIP −3,032' steps down on 'private deals, employee plans'
'Over 30 days to file −4,028' steps down
'Price under $1 −5,630' steps down; 'Eligible buys 65,106' bar lands

beats.narration_text: About sixty-five thousand buys are left to test — six and a half percent of all transactions.

show.event: '65,106' lands large: 'eligible buys'
typeset 65,106 / 999,542 ≈ 6.5% writes in on 'six and a half percent', the 6.5% boxed
'of all Form 4 / transactions' under the equation; '4,146 issuers' / '38,320 filings' settles beneath

beats.narration_text: We checked twenty-five random buys against the original filings: no errors beyond rounding.

show.event: title 'Spot-Check vs. / Original Filings', '25 random buys'; 25 empty tiles in a 5x5 grid
15 tiles fill solid with a check, legend '15 exact match', as 'twenty-five random buys' lands
10 tiles fill hatched, legend '10 rounding only'; on 'checked against the original filings'; example 'e.g. filed $166.1941' / 'data set $166.19'
legend '0 other errors' lands on 'no errors beyond rounding'

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in p-value, knowledge-cutoff and claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: Every filter was fixed before any return was computed. Changing one later would void the test.

show.event: title 'Rules First' settles
items reveal in order: Filters fixed first, Change later = void

qc.sparse_reason: FormBCard's card grid for 2-3 short items doesn't reach 55% fill by design (same characteristic as the passing FormBCard beats in p-value, knowledge-cutoff and claude-liam-context-window).

beats.narration_text: Summary: most Form 4 transactions aren't buys. Whether the eligible buys predict anything hasn't been tested.

show.event: title 'Summary' settles
items reveal in order: Few rows are buys, 65,106 eligible buys, Returns: not tested

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste a Form 4 and ask: what's the transaction code, and is it a real open-market buy? Check: did it read the footnotes?

show.event: greeting reads 'Your turn.'
the suggested prompt types into the composer
send arms
held on the armed composer for 'Check: did it read the footnotes?'

props.command: Here's a Form 4: [paste it]. What's the transaction code, and is it a real open-market buy?

qc.sparse_reason: OutroSeries is a deliberately minimal centered sign-off card (eyebrow + one serif line + underline) on open ground.

beats.narration_text: Most Insider Trades Aren't Buys. At Humanitarians AI — Bella, in for Gomathy.

show.event: eyebrow '@HumanitariansAI' settles
serif line 'Most Insider / Trades / Aren't Buys' settles beneath it
ink underline draws in
